statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 9, low, for the 05:00Z hour, down from 11. Nasdaq-100 futures are 29,276.25 at 05:16Z, 111.50 points and 0.38% lower, about 15 points above an overnight low of 29,261.25 that was set before 04:00Z and has not been extended since. That stall is the reason Tail eases: holding near an extreme is only a Tail amplifier while the extreme keeps giving way, and the whole 219-point band still spans just 0.75% with both edges faded earlier in the session. S&P 500 futures are 0.10% lower in a 0.31% range, so the drag stays Nasdaq-specific. Cross-asset evidence conflicts rather than confirms: VIX 14.89, Treasury futures bid, crude 1.7% lower and gold higher. Tail remains far below the block threshold. The danger window is held narrow at 18:00Z-20:00Z around the scheduled Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions.
recommendation: The overnight decline has stalled rather than developed into a trend. Nasdaq-100 futures printed 29,480.25, rotated twice through a 29,301-29,470 band, extended marginally to 29,261.25 before 04:00Z and are 29,276.25 at 05:16Z, with that low intact for more than an hour. The single amplifier present in the previous hour, price pressing a fresh low, has not produced follow-through, and there is no sequence of shallow pullbacks or repeated extension after failed retracements. Cross-asset confirmation is absent: S&P 500 futures are 0.10% lower, Dow futures near flat, VIX is 14.89 after a 6.00% Friday decline, Treasury futures are modestly bid with the 30-year near 5.276%, WTI is 1.72% lower at $85.56 and gold futures are 0.35% higher at $4,697.20. Delayed cross-asset context collected at 04:31Z was consistent with these live readings and was used only as confirmation. Tail is therefore set at 9 and the mapped policy state is EA_ON. Stress stays moderate at 39 because the week's catalyst stack is heavy: the Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions this afternoon, PCE and Nvidia results on Wednesday and the Jackson Hole keynote on Friday. The narrow 18:00Z-20:00Z danger window remains the part of the day where an energy-led repricing could plausibly change the character of the path.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures stall above the 29,261 overnight low in a 0.75% band; Tail eases to 9, low, mapped state EA_ON
body: Nasdaq-100 futures are 29,276.25 at 05:16Z, 111.50 points and 0.38% lower, roughly 15 points above the 29,261.25 overnight low. That low was set before 04:00Z and has not been extended in the intervening hour, while price has ticked modestly higher, so the near-extreme amplifier that lifted Tail to 11 has faded and the reading returns to 9. The full overnight band of 219.00 points spans only 0.75% of index value and both edges were faded earlier in the session. Weakness remains index-specific: S&P 500 futures are 7,683.75, 0.10% lower in a 23.75-point range, and Dow futures are near flat. Alibaba priced 710 million new shares at HK$112.70, a HK$80 billion and $10.2 billion placement at a 3.6% discount to fund full-stack AI capability, the largest primary follow-on ever by a Hong Kong-listed company; the Hong Kong line fell sharply and put AI capital-spending dilution back in focus days before Nvidia reports. Latest-session semiconductor tone was soft, with the semiconductor industry group 0.31% lower and ARM and Intel down 2.95% and 2.24%, while megacap performance was split, five of eight higher with Tesla up 5.14% and Nvidia down 0.98%. Cross-asset evidence does not align with equity weakness. VIX is 14.89, down 6.00% at the Friday close, in a 14.77-15.95 range. H.15 for 20 August shows the 2-year at 4.19%, the 5-year at 4.39% and the 10-year at 4.69%, with the 30-year near 5.276% and close to a 19-year peak, and Treasury futures are modestly bid overnight. WTI is $85.56, 1.72% lower, and Brent $92.95, 1.52% lower, as investors take profits before the sanctions announcement after both contracts gained more than 5% last week. Gold futures are $4,697.20, up 0.35%, with the metal more than 14% higher for August. Asian equities are mixed to modestly lower, with the Nikkei 0.31% lower, the TOPIX 0.21% higher, Korea down 0.8%, Taiwan down 0.5% and MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan down 0.2%. Reported market pricing implies roughly a 40% chance of a Federal Reserve rate increase at the 16 September meeting, which is a background hawkish risk for long-duration technology. Scheduled catalysts dominate the forward path: the Chicago Fed National Activity Index at 12:30Z, the US cash open at 13:30Z, and the Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions at 18:00Z, which anchors the 18:00Z-20:00Z danger window. Delayed cross-asset context collected at 04:31Z was consistent with these primary readings and was used only as confirmation, never as live price-path evidence.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the published Claude Tail reading stayed in a 4-15 band and the mapped policy state was EA_ON in every hour with an assessment. Four hours, 07:00Z and 10:00Z to 12:00Z on 23 August, have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Through the weekend session Tail held at 4 while Stress climbed steadily from 35 to 45 as the Iran sanctions announcement approached. Tail then rose to 15 at 22:00Z on the Globex reopen and eased through 9, 8 and 7 before oscillating between 7 and 11 as the overnight band was rotated in both directions, ending the window at 11 for the 04:00Z hour. Dominant mode was recorded as normal in every available hour and Confidence stayed in an 82-87 range.
outlookSummary: The 24-hour outlook keeps Tail in a 9-19 band and the mapped policy state at EA_ON throughout, with the danger window held narrow at 18:00Z-20:00Z. Conditional Tail holds at 9 through the remaining Asian hours, edges to 10 across the European open and morning, then lifts to 15-16 into the 13:30Z US cash open, where an opening auction that extends with shallow pullbacks is the structure to watch. It eases through midday and peaks at 19, still below the block threshold, for the two hours covering the scheduled Treasury news conference on new Iran sanctions and the delayed second-leg risk that overlaps the US close. Tail then decays through the post-close and Globex reopen back toward 10 for the Asian hours of 25 August. Stress rises from 39 to a 50 peak inside the danger window and drifts back to the low 40s as proximity to Wednesday's PCE release and Nvidia results builds. Confidence decays from 86 to 65 with horizon.
